English: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with Reading 7.0, Writing 7.0, Listening 8.0, Speaking 8.0.
programs.fees: AUD 26,200 per year (estimated annual fee shown on the course page; the page is displayed in domestic fee-paying view, and international students are full fee-paying students).

programs.entryRequirements: For international applicants, Macquarie's guide shows a selection rank of 75 for the degree. Indonesia SMA3/MA3 is the relevant secondary qualification type, with IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and no band below 6.0.
programs.fees: AUD 45,700 per year (indicative international tuition)

programs.duration: Follows the parent degree (Bachelor of Arts); major itself is not a standalone degree
programs.entryRequirements: Must be admitted into a compatible bachelor degree that offers this major, namely Bachelor of Arts. For Indonesian applicants, Macquarie recognises SMA3/MA3 as an accepted senior secondary qualification at undergraduate level, and English is generally Competent English (typically IELTS 6.5 overall) unless the parent degree has a higher requirement.
programs.fees: No standalone fee is published on the major page; tuition is charged through the parent degree (Bachelor of Arts).
